name: manage_status_epilepticus
description: Manage status epilepticus with benzodiazepines and anti-epileptic drugs following AES guidelines for convulsive and non-convulsive status

seizure_duration_min.description: Duration of continuous seizure activity in minutes

medications_administered.description: Medications already given for current episode

intubation_required.description: Whether intubation is needed for airway protection

when_to_use: Continuous seizure activity lasting more than 5 minutes
Recurrent seizures without return to baseline between episodes
Established status epilepticus unresponsive to initial benzodiazepines
Refractory status epilepticus requiring anesthetic agents
Non-convulsive status epilepticus detected on EEG

examples.query: Patient seizing for 15 minutes, given lorazepam 4mg IV without response
Refractory status epilepticus, 45 minutes, not responding to benzos or levetiracetam
